unsupported.why: Minor overreach. D-2026-031 covers only aging buckets ('aging buckets use calendar days after due date'). Applying it to the ap_pipeline delay_days history is the agent's inference, not something the decision log says. It is worded as 'should' and the row is marked conditional, so the impact is low, but it should be shown as an assumption rather than as part of the decision.
